description: Key derivation and encodings of the registered signature schemes. For each vector the keys are sign.Scheme.DeriveKey(seed) of the named scheme, encoded with MarshalBinary. The signature is the deterministic variant (FIPS 204 deterministic ML-DSA with an empty context, RFC 8032 Ed25519); a hybrid signature concatenates its halves, each signed with its half of the seed. hpqc itself signs ML-DSA hedged, so its signatures differ but verify the same way. Vectors are deterministic.
